title: Jiang Gan Carries a Letter Home; Cao Cao Beheads His Own Admirals
summary: Cao Cao's fleet is handled by two surrendered Jing province admirals — the only men in his army who understand the river. Zhou Yu, visited by an old schoolfellow now working for Cao Cao, gets drunk on purpose, leaves a forged letter where it will be found, and talks in his sleep.
Jiang Gan steals the letter and rides home with it. Cao Cao has both admirals executed before the ink is dry, and understands what he has done about a minute afterwards.
history: Invented. But the two admirals were real, and Cao Cao really did lose the only competent naval officers he had.

pins.note: Kills the only two men who understood the river.
